_comment: Elite skill evolutions: skill id -> target id -> every requirement must hold. A path with an unknown trigger or no requirements never evolves anybody. Triggers: ability_mastered {skill?}, active_title_evolution {title | titles}, awakening_evolution {kind: any|demon_lord|hero}, ep_gate {min}, forge_crafted_count {count}, forge_quality {min: 1-6 or common..mythical}, has_title {title}, held_title_count {count}, item_consume {item, count} (paid only when everything else passed), kill_evolution {count, filter: any|boss|monster|undead, withSkill}, record_unlocked {record}, reset_count {count}. A data pack may replace this file (same path) or add paths in its own copy; later packs win per (skill, target). The title and record ids below are the names this subsystem expects the records and titles subsystem to define; until it does, those two requirements simply do not pass.
